market_view: Risk appetite recovered: VIX fell 17% to 17.1 and chips rebounded sharply on 07-30 after the rout; the Fed held, the dollar slipped and the 10-year sits near 4.66%, close to its 1-year high. Earnings season and the jobs report add variance.

oil_gas.catalyst: none: 'ExxonMobil Announces Second-Quarter 2026 Results' (ExxonMobil) is a known profit surge, offset by 'Chevron and Exxon earnings soar as Trump threatens price interventions' (Financial Times)
oil_gas.reasoning: Q2 windfall is backward-looking and widely reported; Brent fell 11.6% in five days as Iran tensions eased, and political price-intervention threats are a one-sided risk. No renewed Hormuz escalation, so the re-entry rule has not fired.

gold_miners.reasoning: Gold +1.6% and NEM +4.8% on 07-30 with a weaker dollar after the Fed hold, but that move is priced. Yields stay near the 1-year high and gold is 23% off its high; options-chatter headlines are not catalysts. Jobs report adds variance only.

chips.catalyst: none: 'AMD and Micron surge, Lam Research climbs 17% as chip stocks rip higher' (CNBC) restates a move already in prices
chips.reasoning: Semiconductor ETF +6.9% and NVDA +2.7% in one day after a rout; a rebound is not a catalyst. No NVDA-specific news or export-control change. Stress-regime volatility argues for staying out.

pharma.reasoning: LLY fell 4.6% on 07-30 with no headline explaining it; LLY Q2 results are still ahead. Long only on a guidance raise or filing news, which has not appeared. Pharma bad-news event days dominate.

copper_uranium.catalyst: 'Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring' (CNBC, 2026-07-31): a supply shock to FCX's commodity
copper_uranium.reasoning: Storm-related outages plus an existing global squeeze are a persistent supply story that can last weeks rather than days; copper +2.7% and FCX +5.8% already, so edge is small. Copper is 3% off its 1-year high with a weaker dollar supporting it.

would_change_my_mind: Copper supply returning quickly or a dollar rebound would cut FCX to flat; renewed tanker attacks or Hormuz closure with crude not repriced would reopen XOM; an LLY guidance raise at Q2 would justify a pharma long.

handoff.what_changed: Exxon and Chevron reported a record wartime Q2 ($26.5B combined) but Trump threatened price interventions and Brent kept falling (-11.6% in 5 days). Chips rebounded sharply on 07-30 (SOXX +6.9%, AMD +13%) and VIX fell to 17. CNBC reports storms and a global supply squeeze sending copper soaring; opened a long FCX on that catalyst.

oil_gas.why: Q2 windfall already reported and oil falling as Iran tensions ease; Trump price-intervention threat is a downside risk.

gold_miners.why: Gold bounce on a weaker dollar after the Fed hold is priced; yields near 1-year high; no catalyst.

chips.why: One-day rebound after a rout is not a catalyst; no NVDA-specific news.

pharma.why: LLY fell 4.6% on 07-30 without a headline; waiting for Q2 guidance.

copper_uranium.why: CNBC 'Deadly storms and a global supply squeeze are sending copper prices soaring' is a persistent supply shock; exit if supply returns or copper reverses on a stronger dollar.

open_storylines.name: Iran war / Hormuz oil shock
open_storylines.note: Brent 89, down 11.6% in 5 days. Re-enter XOM only on renewed tanker attacks or chokepoint closure with crude not yet repriced.

open_storylines.name: Oil windfall and Trump price interventions
open_storylines.note: Record XOM/CVX Q2 profits drew Trump's ire and intervention threats; watch for windfall tax, export limits or SPR actions (negative for XOM).

open_storylines.name: Gold bear market and rising yields
open_storylines.note: 10-year 4.66% near 1-year high; Fed held this week; watch the jobs report, dollar and NEM news.

open_storylines.name: Chip rout and rebound
open_storylines.note: Rout from Seoul then a sharp 07-30 rebound; watch NVDA news, export rules and big tech capex in earnings.

open_storylines.name: US global tariffs and inflation
open_storylines.note: Trade partners rebuke the forced-labor rationale; euro area inflation 2.9%; watch metals and energy carve-outs and retaliation.

open_storylines.name: LLY Q2 earnings and retatrutide
open_storylines.note: LLY -4.6% on 07-30 unexplained; long only on a guidance raise or regulator filing news at Q2 results.

open_storylines.name: Copper supply squeeze
open_storylines.note: Storms and a global squeeze sent copper +2.7% to 6.44, 3% off its 1-year high; FCX long. Watch mine restarts, China demand, the dollar and FCX news.

open_storylines.name: Uranium: Cameco Q2, Westinghouse IPO, DRC undeclared exports
open_storylines.note: Cameco reports record uranium prices and plans a Westinghouse IPO; studies show undeclared uranium from the DRC. Indirect for FCX.

open_storylines.name: Copper to aluminium substitution
open_storylines.note: FCX demand headwind if more automakers switch; no update.

handoff.next_job: On the next decision day, read this note; confirm the FCX long filled and check the copper supply story (exit if supply recovers or copper reverses on a dollar rebound; the 20-day hold ends around 2026-08-28). Re-check the four flat families for a named catalyst: Iran/Hormuz re-escalation or Trump oil interventions for XOM, LLY Q2 guidance, NVDA or export-control news, and gold on yields and the jobs report.
